name: 32, Dandelion Drift
source: Accompany Dan and Claire on their journey throughout the years and witness the birth of their new home. Experience a life story unfolding with every room you renovate, and discover the secrets, that maybe should have been buried for eternity. And then, when the warm glow of the afternoon wanes…that’s when the real struggle begins.
translation: 陪伴丹和克莱尔走过这些年的旅程，见证他们新家的诞生。体验你翻新的每个房间的生活故事，并发现也许应该永远埋藏的秘密。然后，当午后的温暖光芒消退时……真正的斗争才开始。
